experience_2: Built an internal tool that automated a manual data-labeling step, cutting labeling turnaround time from 2 days to 4 hours.

selected_project.title: Project Cascade — Course-Enrollment Demand Classifier
selected_project.technology_line: Python, XGBoost, scikit-learn, SHAP, FastAPI, React
bullets: Benchmarked six machine-learning classifiers against four scheduling-heuristic baselines for next-term course-enrollment demand using point-in-time, time-ordered validation.
Achieved a 0.61 held-out ROC-AUC with XGBoost and a 0.59 mean ROC-AUC across 12 expanding-window terms.
